title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace

meta.Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Line: A few days before meeting with the Asahinas

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Were you taking a nap, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. It is nice and sunny out today. She must have gotten comfy.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I got really sleepy after we had lunch!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You did eat your lunch right up, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: That's because it was so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Daddy! I wanna hear one of your songs!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Sure. How about I play “Kanade and Mommy's Happy Sunday”?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I had a dream like that.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mom, Dad and I were all smiling and laughing...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should get back to work...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still don't know much about Mafuyu's mom, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I also want to know more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to see if what I felt was real.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(That's why...
I need to keep trying to compose a song which can save her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? Nobody else is on Nightcord right now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come over here and take a look.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More specifically, it's covered in what look like black fragments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The leaves are starting to wilt.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We don't know.
It was like this when we got here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I mean, what's gonna happen to it?
It is just going to completely wither away...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Who knows? This is the only thing even close to a plant in this SEKAI. There's no real telling how it works.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But we know it was born from your feelings. Maybe those same feelings could end up killing it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But that hasn't happened yet, so there might be something we can do to save it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If these fragments are just stuck on, maybe we can try to pull them off.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For example, I can get this one...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for making breakfast again today, Kanade. This looks delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. The omelets turned out really well today. Try them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You made them sweet the other day, but these are much more savory. I'm impressed by your cooking skills, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I put some real effort in today.
Which do you like better, Dad?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I like everything that you make.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That doesn't help me at all.
I asked because I want to make what you like, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, Dad, you have bags under your eyes.
Did you stay up all night again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I was planning to go to a good stopping point, and the next thing I knew, the sun was coming up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Dad...
Don't come crying to me if you get sick again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... I know a lot of people are looking forward to your next song. Everyone says your music makes them happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to compose songs the way you do someday, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: But you'll need to study hard to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I know.
I have to learn as much as I can to broaden my skillset as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I still don't like studying for tests...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. Then, if you get good scores, I'll give you a reward.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time...
I need to get going.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The passage you all just heard describes the characters' thoughts and feelings in very subtle ways.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Please take a minute now to write down what you think those thoughts and feelings were.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This part... She seemed really sad when she realized that her dream would never come true. But she was able to reunite with her friend, who she thought she'd never see again. So, she must be feeling happier than sad.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She hardly ever cries, but she was overcome with joy...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I turned what she's feeling in this moment into a song...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki?
What are you writing there?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Kanade! Were you composing another song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I was...
A good melody popped into my head, so...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha! You just can't help it, can you?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Weren't you warned just the other day for doing the same thing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I was...
I know I need to pay attention during class.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
But you come up with the most amazing songs!
I always feel better after listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yes, really. I always listen to them while walking over to school. Even if I'm feeling down, I'm all cheered up by the time I get here!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh yeah, the videos of your songs have tens of thousands of views, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think that makes me famous or anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it is nice to know that a lot of people are listening to my songs.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hehe. You are always talking about how you want to make people happy through your songs just like your dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but my songs still leave a lot to be desired.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Not true!
I mean, you've already made me happy♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How could I have forgotten my things? I knew we'd be meeting in a different classroom next...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I just told Dad that I'd do my best at school...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
I was spacing out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? You know who I am?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm in the next class over, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you. My name is Mafuyu Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes, nice to meet you too...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, next period is going to start soon. We'd better get going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've heard her name before, but I didn't realize she knew who I was.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope I get to talk to her again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's nice that I'm in the same class as my two closest friends again, but I haven't talked to most of the others.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I can't just stand here staring at my feet forever.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should start by greeting everyone...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Morning, Kanade!
I'm so glad we're in the same class again!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's make this year another great one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
I feel so much better knowing that you two are here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha. It's pretty awkward when you're surrounded by a bunch of unfamiliar faces, huh. I'm glad we're together again too!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we're in the same class again this year, Mafuyu! Let's have lots of fun together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to this upcoming year. But you need to make an effort to do your homework on your own, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm in the same class as Asahina...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What a surprise to see we're in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I'm also a little happy.
I was hoping to get to know you a little better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I look forward to being your classmate.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This part needs to have more of a skip to its step...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, this sounds good.
Now, the next part should give the listener a sense of clarity...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Was someone singing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Or did I just imagine that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But that gentle voice sounded so real.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm, for that feeling I just had...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I thought we could have dinner soon.
Do you have any requests?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's already that late?
I'm sorry. I completely forgot...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I finished working early today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Your music sounds like you're having more fun than usual today, so I didn't want to interrupt your work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: W-Was it really coming through that clearly?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes, your music was especially bouncy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We were assigned to new classes today, and I'm in the same class as a girl I've been wanting to talk to for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like maybe we could be friends.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That's a nice twist of fate.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Kanade! You uploaded that new song last night, right?! It's so good!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You came up with another really fun song. I got all excited just listening to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I got to work on it the second I got home, so I was worried it might feel a little rushed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad you both like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What?! You made it that fast?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
You really are amazing...
You make such good music, and so fast too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You three seem to be having fun.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, you gotta listen to this!
Kanade's new song is really awesome!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Yoisaki, you write your own songs?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Kanade's really amazing!
She posts her songs online as “K”, and she's super popular!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Really now?
I do like listening to music, so I'd love to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Of course...!
Um, this is my latest one...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I really like this other one too! Give it a listen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It feels so weird being outside during the day like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah, that'll happen when you're always cooped up indoors.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get it.
But we're getting your feet back under you, so you'll just have to bear it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on. Those pancakes won't eat themselves!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Two orders of our heart-shaped fruit pancakes.
They'll be out shortly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The pancakes here are really good.
I'm sure you're gonna love them, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Airi must be so busy with all her idol work...
I really can't thank her enough for doing this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If she didn't contact me that time, then I probably would've...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Every time, I feel like I'm getting somewhere, and then it all just falls apart on me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Look at all these comments...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone... They're praising me so much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is this all there is for me?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not being able to draw. Not acknowledged by anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Do I really have to keep living on like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really haven't done much lately other than sleep and fiddle with my phone.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Turns out you don't really get hungry if you spend the whole day sleeping...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I bet my skin's a nightmare, but who cares? Even taking selfies is too much of a hassle.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Nothing matters now. I'm sick of everything...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So this is what's popular lately?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know you're super busy...
I feel really terrible about making you meet with me over and over again like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wouldn't be much of an idol if I didn't take the time to help my best friend, would I?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm here because I want to be here!
So... Ena, there's no need for you to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I hate reading long passages in English...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know what each word means, but reading them as parts of sentences and paragraphs is so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But things were a lot worse in first year when I'd just returned to being a regular student.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After studying like crazy, I've finally reached a point where I can keep up during class...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, we'll continue this discussion during our next class. Please make sure to read ahead and review what we did today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That class was such a drag.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I'm so bad at English. I started getting sleepy partway through.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You'd better study up, or you'll regret it during our next quiz.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
But I just can't get it into my brain.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: Behold my notebook! It's basically blank!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, is this one supposed to be Shibunyago?

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really love him!
I thought things would be easier to understand if I drew illustrations of him explaining everything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, if you take what we talked about during class just now, then I guess it'd go something like this? It was about going on vacation and ice skating, so you could draw him on the ice...

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa!
Ena, you're an amazing artist!

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
How did you do that so fast?!
Also, he looks so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
It's just a simple doodle...

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
No, this is amazing!
Here, this page is untouched! You can use it to draw more pictures!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you need to use it to study.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
Guys, you gotta see this!
Ena drew it just now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Wait, really?! I didn't know you were such a good artist, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That's it for classes...
I don't have any other plans today, so I think I'll go do some shopping.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, Ena! Can I ask you for a tiny favor?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I work for the school paper, and we're publishing a special issue this month! So, we need a pretty big illustration for it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: And when I saw your drawings the other day, I knew it just had to be you! Whatcha say?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Would you also be willing to draw something for our poster, Shinonome? We really need this one to grab everyone's attention...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone will love whatever you draw, and you can take all the time you need...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're really laying it on thick...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, I'm in. Can you start by telling me what this poster is for?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
That took longer than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's been so long since I did such a big piece. I honestly thought that I'd locked away my paints for good.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: And when I saw your drawings the other day, I knew it just had to be you! Whatcha say?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone will love whatever you draw, and you can take all the time you need...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They're expecting something good from me, so I have to hold up my end.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's 25:00? I still don't feel like going to bed yet, but I've finished drawing everything I was asked to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Do I really have any right at this point?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Feeling like drawing again after all this time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Don't be an idiot... Just because a couple classmates said they liked your doodles...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That was weird. I could've sworn that I heard a song just now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know what that was...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But it felt a little nostalgic somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
Congratulations on what?
Wait, you won a prize from that contest?! Way to go, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, hey! Don't scare me like that.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: You should be able to get into that art school you're always talking about no problem now, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's a completely different story.
It just isn't that easy.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: Still, Ena, you've basically been spending all your time drawing lately. You hardly ever respond to my messages in the evening.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: Does that mean you're at home drawing nonstop?

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: I knew it! You really are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: I'm not just talking about your ability to draw nonstop. You work all by yourself, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: I'd definitely get lonely, myself. I need someone to talk to!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I never really thought about it like that.
I'm just so used to it now.

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
What?!
Does that mean you're actually really lonely?!

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: Let me know if you ever wanna meet! I'll come right over!

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line: Wait, whoa! Look at the time!

rows.Speaker: Friend
rows.Line:
I've gotta go!
See you later! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (True, when you spend all day every day drawing, you sort of end up emptied out of everything else.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's what it means to make art.
So, that's really just how it goes.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: All these clothes are so adorable...

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
Oh, I really like this skirt.
But it might be a little too cutesy for me...

Isn't that just the cutest?!
It's a brand-new piece that we just got in!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
Really?
I don't know, I'm just not sure if it suits me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
I actually think it suits you really well♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you're looking for something a little less cutesy, then how about this one in blue?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The silhouette is about the same, but it's a much more refreshing color. So, it should give off a completely different impression!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
You're right.
I might actually be able to pull this one off...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like it!
By the way, this also looks really cute as part of a layered outfit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For example, if you wore this with a turtleneck or a collared blouse... Like this!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: While we're at it, I'd love to hear which accessories would go well with this outfit. Do you have any recommendations?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Actually, I have just the thing for you!
They're right this way♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, these are the ones I was talking about. Please have a look!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
Wow...! These earrings are adorable!
The big bows make such a nice accent...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, and they look amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They go really well with the outfit you're wearing right now, so you could wear them home!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
I could...!
Alright, I'll get these...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much!
Then, I'll get everything put together for you right away♪

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Nice work, Akiyama!
That lady really fell in love with those earrings!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad that she ended up liking them so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It really is nice to hear a person say that they like something you made.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Hehe. Your handmade accessories have really made a splash.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what you make next.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you! It might take a little while, but I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Oh, it's just about time, so why don't you clock off?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank goodness I was able to buy that extra lace! Once I get home, I'll attach it to the skirt hem, and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, this skirt in the window is so cute!
Is it new?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... But that blouse is also...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this blouse is really nice...
I might grab it while I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's got a pretty good eye to pick out that blouse.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And the outfit she's wearing's really stylish. Hehe. I bet we'd get along great.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I can't buy both...
So, for now, I'll go with this skirt.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, that's the hem pretty much done. Next, I'll give it some gather, then attach it to the rest...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew, so much work left to do! I should take a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, I'll watch this anime.
Play!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. That episode was so good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was mostly a comedic episode, but some of the things that happened at the end had implications for later. I remember people talking about that on social media.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: People were going pretty hard on the theorycrafting. Wonder how it's looking now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah, this!
The expressions they made at the end are the same as the ones in the opening. That totally blew my mind when I realized it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
What's this song I just got recommended?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Who made this? Someone called K?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The thumbnail's super simple. Just text...
Sure, I'll give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... It's pretty upbeat.
Has stuff like this been trending lately?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what about this person's song?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, I know! This song would be perfect for a heartwarming fan video!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm getting inspired already. Time to get storyboarding!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, there we are!
This video's gonna be just the cutest!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already morning?
Time sure flew by...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (When I was still in school, I never got to use my time this freely.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'd always get stuck thinking about having to go back tomorrow, and everything else...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Thinking about it that way, things are easier now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad I dropped out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Today's event was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Every booth was so cute that I wanted to stay there forever!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
I know what you mean!
Speaking of which, Amia, you sell your works at a shop, right? Makes sense, with that level of quality!

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Yeah! I've bought one of your creations myself♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks!
It's nice to see people like you two wearing the stuff I made.

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to seeing what you make next! Do you already have an event in mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Not yet.
My next one might take me a little while.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've actually gotten into making clothes lately.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Wait, you're making clothes now?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm still just getting started, so they're really nothing special!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Starting from scratch is a lot harder than I thought it would be.
I'm working on a dress right now, but it's nowhere near ready.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: But we're talking a dress made by Amia! I know it's going to be absolutely adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But I'm not sure I can accept money for it since it's just the first one. I can't guarantee quality.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd take even more time to get it to a level where I'd be comfy with someone wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Oh, then, why don't we make it together?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
I'm actually really good at sewing.
I've even made my own clothes in the past!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: If we work together, Amia, then I'm sure we'll be able to create some really adorable outfits!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I kinda want to focus on working solo right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But maybe we'll get a chance sometime in the future♪

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Still, I can't wait to see how your dress turns out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's nice having people around I can talk about cute things with.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was a little surprised when she asked me to make that dress with her, though...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Long time no see.
Did you just get out of school?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I was about to head over for practice.
I had a committee meeting, so I wasn't able to leave until a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, nifty.
What are you working on now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We've been training with the Morinomiya Revue.
It's been hard, but also very enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, THE Morinomiya Revue?!
That's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We were fortunate enough to get an introduction.
And now, we get to learn and train together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, things are going well with Tsukasa and the others?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope you guys all get to make your dreams come true together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. We're working toward them together, step by step.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki... Are you sure you won't come back to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I'm having so much fun right now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll also support your decision.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm this way.
Good luck with practice♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Rui sounds like he's really enjoying life.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He has friends he can count on now. Not like before.)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Hey look, you-know-who's here today!
Talk about girlier than your average girl, just like everyone says.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
I mean, it's not like I care.
I just feel like if you don't want people talking about you, maybe you should dress like a normal person.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Why even dress that way anyway?
Desperate for attention much?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: It's probably better to keep your distance. Who knows what people might think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Things are so much easier now that I'm not going to school anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I get to dress how I feel, make whatever I want and watch whatever I like.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I get to be free. I get to be myself...
Which is way more fun.)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Oh, then, why don't we make it together?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
I'm actually really good at sewing.
I've even made my own clothes in the past!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's just more trouble than it's worth.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Is someone singing...? But where...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know, but it felt like such a gentle song...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I've gotta get home and continue working on that dress!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Are you sure about this, Mafuyu?
We don't mean to drag you along.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I was actually hoping to take a breather today anyway.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear!
Let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Rare item: Print Stickers with Mafuyu, obtained!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My skin looks so good in these photos. What a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's the selling point of this machine, after all. I actually like the one over there a little more. Wanna give it a try next?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Check out this blouse! Isn't it adorable?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it is. And it suits you very well.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh, Mafuyu, I bet this skirt would look great on you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You think so? I do own a few clothes with similar designs, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. There's a shop that I was hoping to visit. Can we go there next?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Still, Mafuyu, I didn't realize you liked these kinds of shops.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've been meaning to visit it after spotting it on my way home the other day.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, I see! I don't usually wear these kinds of clothes, but it's fun just looking at them, huh.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Since we're here, let's have a good look around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Are you looking for anything in particular?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're right about that!
I also really love all the clothes we have here♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know, miss, you look very grown-up, so I might have a dress that suits you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We just got it in the other day.
Would you like to take a look at it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you don't have to try it on!
I just personally think that you'd look really amazing in it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Then, maybe just a quick look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you!
Right this way...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had so much fun today.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Don't act like the day's over.
We can't go home until we've had these pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Their heart-shaped fruit pancakes are very famous. Anyway, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This whipped cream isn't too terribly sweet, so I can just keep on eating.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Me too! I might have room for seconds!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Uh, wouldn't that be going a little overboard?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
These pancakes are just that good!
Apparently they have different flavors for different seasons too. I wonder what they are.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's come back again some day when Mafuyu's free!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
I hope Yoisaki can join us next time.
She said she couldn't today because she'd be busy working on a song.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
She's really famous online, right?
Do you think that means she writes new songs every single day?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I'm sure she's free sometimes. Let's invite her again sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you like it?
I tried preparing it a little differently today, so I'm glad you're enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Everything you make is good, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mafuyu, have you already decided which school you're going to apply to?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You mentioned a little while back that you'd like to become a doctor, so I figured that you'd be trying for schools with medical programs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, about that... We actually discussed that the other day. Mafuyu said...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She isn't completely set on becoming a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It sounds like she wishes to do something that allows her to be there for people. So I think we should give her time to think it over.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
You wish to be there for people. You really do have a big heart, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Regardless of the path you choose in life, I'm sure you'll find a way to succeed, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Congratulations on placing third at the Kanto High Schools Invitational Archery Tournament. I hereby award you with this certificate to mark your great achievement.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: She placed third! She really is amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: She's top of the class too, and she even won an award the other day for that essay she wrote. She really can do it all!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for the wait. Especially after I invited you to walk home together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay. But what did that teacher need from you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, the school's apparently revising the pamphlet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They wanted to know if it'd be okay for them to include a photo of me from today's ceremony in the gym.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really are an amazing person, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Between the archery club and school in general, you keep achieving all these incredible results.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All I know how to do is compose songs. So I'm just really impressed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Don't say that, Yoisaki.
Your songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They're a source of warmth for so many people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I didn't realize that's how they sound to you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But my songs still leave a lot to be desired. I'm still nothing compared to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know. Are there any things that you'd like to try other than composing songs?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Whatever is fine.
Anything that interests you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I am a little interested in the brass band.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, since playing music with others seems like fun. I feel like doing so would help broaden my horizons as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Also, I'm not very good at writing essays...
Expanding my vocabulary and learning how to write better should help me produce better lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I'd like to learn how to draw.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Is that also to become a better composer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's right. I sometimes draw inspiration for songs from art. I feel like drawing things myself would let me see things from a different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, you should try doing all those things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. It's like you said, who knows what might be of use to you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Still, all of them...?
I don't know if I can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then, I'll help you.
We can try them together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give them all a try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... In modern society, music serves as a source of happiness and relaxation for people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good. Your writing has improved quite a lot compared to where you were initially.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm starting to find it kind of fun thanks to you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Composing text is just like composing songs. I just need to write what I feel. And while I'm writing, the “melody” just seems to naturally come together as I go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Lately, lyrics have been popping into my head before any music. I feel like I can go about composing in so many different ways now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. In that case, I'll be looking forward to listening to your next song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think I've drawn this right. But what's wrong with it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
The background looks fine from my point of view, but it does feel a little cluttered, maybe.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling.
I wanted to add some trees to the foreground, but I'm not sure there's any room now...
In that case, why don't you just draw what you want to the most?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What I want to the most...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. You're trying to draw everything, so you're losing focus and losing impact.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're Yoisaki, right?
Can you tell me what you're trying to capture?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I wanted to show the way the sun sparkles on the lake in between the big trees...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, you should focus more on how the light reflects off the water's surface. Like this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...
It looks so much better already. But all you did was draw a couple lines.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is pretty basic stuff, you know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Thank you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Ena looks like she's having fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I agree. Momoi, thank you again for introducing Shinonome to us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No problem. Ena has a habit of staying cooped up in her room if she's not given opportunities to meet people like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I think she needs breaks like this too.

rows.Speaker: Brass Band President
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll start playing in thirty minutes!
We've got a few students here to observe, so we'll be taking it easy today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem a little anxious, Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...yes. I'm mostly excited. I am worried about whether I'll be able to do it right, though.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is also my first time, so let's do our best together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you hadn't brought me here, Asahina, then I probably never would've actually done this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, let's have as much fun as we can today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You seem to be in a good mood lately, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, you've just seemed very lively. Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well, my friends have been having quite a lot of fun lately...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And it makes me happy to see it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
You must care about them quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I'm so glad that you grew up to be such a kind girl.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone seems to be having fun...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, you composed a song for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because you've done so much for me, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You taught me how to write better, learned how to draw with me... And we visited the brass band together, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So I thought, you know, I'd like to give something back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. I did it because I wanted to. Because I've really had a lot of fun with you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll accept my gift.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can I listen to it now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's nice song that's very gentle.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's just...
I get the feeling that it isn't to your liking.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm sorry. I'll make another one. I want to write a song that you genuinely like, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing.
I really do like this song a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to compose anything for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Dad, didn't you say that you'd be gone for that meeting today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I actually just got home a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I composed a song for my friend, but I don't think she liked it very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I thought I'd compose another one for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But she said that I didn't have to.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's only natural my song didn't really resonate with her. I mean, I can't compose the way you do, Dad. I don't know how to make people happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We became friends only just recently, so I can't say that I know her all that well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... Seeing that pain in her eyes... I can't just leave her like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? That's odd...
I feel like I've said that before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: If that's what you wish, Kanade, then it sounds like you've already made up your mind what to do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm going to compose another song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It needs to go deeper and feel colder... But still let a small ray of light shine through...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know why it looked like she was in pain.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It could just be a big misunderstanding.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even if it's for only a second, I want her to smile.)
I'm not sure this song will be able to clear up what's on that girl's mind...
What is it that you want people to see or realize by hearing this?
Your songs really are nice and gentle...
<K, this song will reach her for sure.>
You promise to keep writing music as long as it takes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's why I kept composing all those songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope this one reaches the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it needs to be darker and feel heavier... Like the walls are closing in...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Forget it. This is all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How many times is that? I've lost count.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to keep drawing and drawing and drawing and drawing!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't even know what's good or bad at this point.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I feel like I have to keep drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Hey, have you heard K's new song?>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I did!
It's a little different from her usual stuff.
Kinda dark, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think her old style was better.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: K...? The girl who composes those really cheerful songs?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It wasn't really my cup of tea, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here's the URL...
I guess I can listen to it for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My chest feels so tight and terrible... But also warm...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I can't find the right words for it...
But I need to express this feeling!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try layering on some darker colors here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, that's only the sunken feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It needs more light, more contrast with the shadows...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That K person gave me the push I needed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. I could upload this as a piece of fan art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know if anyone is gonna see it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, why does it feel like I'm forgetting something really important? Like there's a gaping hole in my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? A DM? W-Why? From who...?

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Enanan.
I'll be waiting for you on Nightcord.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter where I go, you always know how to find me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mhm, mhm!
It turned out super cute! And this is my first one! How awesome am I?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want someone to see it, but An's probably asleep... Maybe I'll post it on social media.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, making a piece of clothing from scratch by yourself really takes forever...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I'm just doing it as a hobby, so that doesn't really matter.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, what should I design next?
Another dress might be fun, but I could also change things up and make a piece of outerwear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This song... It's by that K person.
I could take a quick break and listen to it.
<I was able to compose that song because you helped me open my eyes.>
It was nice to see you again...
N25's been waiting for you to come back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Making stuff with the others...
I really love doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How long is this going to last...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You wish to be there for people. You really do have a big heart, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Regardless of the path you choose in life, I'm sure you'll find a way to succeed, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She hasn't been at school since yesterday. I should have guessed she was composing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess going to school every day has helped increase my stamina a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Despite running over here, I feel less tired than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's why I always say you should exercise more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. My body knows that now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu. Did you listen to my song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's not your fault, Kanade.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You could at least let yourself dream of doing anything else.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. I did, and it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But in the end... What I want is to compose for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm also glad that I got to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's go on Nightcord.
I've already contacted Ena and Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This is all a dream? But it feels so real.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know, right? I thought you were supposed to bolt awake once you realize it's all a dream, for stuff like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm not sure that's how things work here.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My memories came back a while ago.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why didn't you say anything, Mafuyu?! That means you were...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Because you all seemed to be enjoying yourselves.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I thought I should leave things be...for at least a little while longer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Not seeing any of you when the clock struck 25:00...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry we left you so alone, Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Honestly! That's even more reason to speak up!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Now, now. Still, this does mean we have a LOT of catching up to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, you wanna work until the sun comes up?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. I wanna draw something for N25. It feels like it's been so long.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry, Dad.
I might be staying up fairly late tonight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
I know you love composing, but please remember to rest when you can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Remember how you said you'd do something for me if I did well on my tests...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Can I ask you for that favor now?
I promise to study really hard...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because... I feel like it's been really long since I last heard you sing one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: A song of support for my hard worker, then. Let me go get my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No matter how hard we tried, you wouldn't wake up. We were so worried...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was dreaming just now, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade, do you remember what that dream was about?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena and Mafuyu and I figured out we all had the same dream, it sounds like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. From what Mafuyu said, you were a student at Miya Girls...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The three of us were able to regain our memories after listening to your song. Then, we got on Nightcord and realized that it was all just a dream...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A dream where N25 never existed...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?! And I dropped out of school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too. I spent all my time drawing, all on my own...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The worst part was how realistic it all felt.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, why did we have that dream at all?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those black fragments are probably the answer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we realized that after you'd all fallen asleep.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those fragments... They were born out of the feelings which had built up in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Pain, sadness, regret, a desire to escape... Those sorts of feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Along with wishes that can never be granted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But those fragments of feelings may be even more complicated than just that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of those messy feelings got mixed around with each other, and made one especially messy dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wishes that can never be granted...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a good way to describe that dream. I mean, there's no way things would just go that well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right. Thank goodness we were able to realize the truth after listening to your song, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Honestly, I'd rather not experience anything like that again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I get why you're worried...
I mean, who knows what's gonna happen in the future?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think you need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just take a look at that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And all the black fragments are gone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This tree was born out of a wide variety of feelings, and your feelings make it grow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those black fragments are your feelings too...so absorbing them must've caused it to grow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-There should be nothing to worry about...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're not making any promises that something like this won't happen again, though.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If something like this does happen again...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No matter what kind of world we end up in, the past or the future...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll find all of you again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... No matter where we end up, I believe that you'll find us, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that dream showed us that for sure.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I believe in you too, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's keep on making music together.
Our music.
